messages:
Omar (CSM): Heads-up: VitalHealth onboarding spike overnight. Renewal in ~6w. Need a 7-day spend projection + short QBR blurb.
Priya (FinOps): grabbing numbers. Do we know burst source?
Kai (Onboard): Bulk user import + realtime similarity jobs. Baseline ~700k tokens/day, peak 5.2M yesterday. Embeddings ~80% of burn.
Zoe (AE): they're concerned about bill variance. Want firm guardrail options to present.
Omar (CSM): fast plan: 1) forecast optimistic/pessimistic 2) enable soft alerts + temporary onboarding credit 3) provide short customer message.
alert-bot: Notice: VitalHealth embedding requests exceeded 450rpm at 2026-03-22T03:40:12Z. 10-min avg=510rpm.
Priya (FinOps): Using hosted standard $0.0008/1k tokens. Scenario high (no throttle) ~ $7.8k over 7d. With throttle+cache ~ $1.9k.
Kai (Onboard): I can apply per-route throttle and add dedupe cache. Quick config I plan to push:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
rate_limit: 180rpm
burst: 40
cache: true
cache_ttl: 86400
```
Zoe (AE): propose one-time onboarding credit $1.5k and soft alert at 60% monthly. Finance sign-off needed.
Omar (CSM): suggested nudge for QBR deck: "Detected high-volume import; we've temporarily throttled ingestion and added an onboarding credit to avoid surprises. We'll review usage and recommended limits at your upcoming QBR."
Priya (FinOps): I'll add two slides (baseline vs mitigated) and email finance for the credit approval. Need final numbers by EOD.
Kai (Onboard): Limits applied. Monitoring shows 62% reduction in peak throughput.
alert-bot: Billing projection: soft threshold (60%) expected in 3 days if current trend continues.
Omar (CSM): thanks team — keep me posted, will slot QBR note once final numbers are in.
